_readme: Registry of where each content source lives in the company SharePoint. The scheduled workflows read THIS file — update a URL here (commit + push) and the sync follows; nothing else to configure. Manual drops into the sources/ folders keep working exactly as before. See sources/README.md and docs/ADMIN.md.

catalog.note: The newest subfolder containing an .idml is the edition (its export PDF also becomes the catalog download artifact). Parent is year-named — point this at the new year's folder when one appears.

success-stories.note: Newest subfolder containing an .idml is the edition (needs .idml + Links/ + export PDF, which the designer's package folders already carry). The tags xlsx is NOT auto-synced — drop it manually when tags change.
